ayahOccurrences.text: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: نُكِسُوا۟ is in the derivative form: نُكِسَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ك/س   n–k–s to turn upside down, to turn down, to reverse, to hang one’s head in shame, to be weak
; to relapse, degeneration.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
نُكِسَ nukisa; نَكَّسَ nakkasa and نَاكِسُون nākisūn.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نُكِسَ nukisa [pass. v.] to be caused to relapse, to be caused to revert, to be turned upside down *

(21:65) نُكِسُوا عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ they went back to their stubbornness, became obstinate [lit. they were turned upside down on their heads].

entries.label: نُكِسَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نُكِسَ nukisa [pass. v.] to be caused to relapse, to be caused to revert, to be turned upside down *

(21:65) نُكِسُوا عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ they went back to their stubbornness, became obstinate [lit. they were turned upside down on their heads].

entries.label: نَاكِسُون
entries.definitionHtml:
نَاكِسُون nākisūn [pl. of act. part. نَاكِسٌ nākis] those who bend something down *

(32:12) نَاكِسُوا رُءُوسِهِمْ hanging their heads [in shame].

entries.label: نَكَّسَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَكَّسَ nakkasa [v. II trans.] to cause to reverse, to turn upside down

(36:68) وَمَنْ نُعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى الْخَلْقِ he whom We bring into very old age We reverse him in constitution [from strength to weakness].
